title: Multiplicity One for Strictly Stable Anisotropic Allen-Cahn Minimal Hypersurfaces
summary: In this paper, we study the multiplicity of smooth limit interfaces for the anisotropic Allen-Cahn equation on closed Riemannian manifolds. We prove that an isolated smooth limit interface has multiplicity one whenever it is a closed, embedded, two-sided, strictly \(F\)-stable \(F\)-minimal hypersurface. The proof uses anisotropic barriers and a sliding argument to confine the nodal sets to a neighborhood of width \(O(\varepsilon)\).
